Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to hear more about Acme Health's plans for embedding clinical-summarization flows into your provider portal. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- What I heard: Primary goal is a sub-150ms/L70 latency target for short summaries, redaction requirements for PHI, and audit logging for 3 years.
- Current constraints: On-prem data residency for PHI, procurement timeline ~Q4, and a P0 integration owner identified (Priya).

Next steps I recommend: 
1) Technical deep dive + demo (30–45m) with Mateo (solutions engineer) to validate latency and integration pattern.
2) Executive alignment call (VP/CTO) to unblock procurement and discuss deployment model (Dedicated vs Private).

Can you share availability for a 30–45m technical session next week? Also you mentioned bringing in your CTO / VP — if you confirm who that will be, I'll loop in our VP (Lauren) to coordinate an exec intro.

Attached is a short demo agenda and internal checklist I’ll use for the technical call.
